sn22.69:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.69:1.3: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || pe || vihareyyan ti || || 4
sn22.69:1.4: Yaṃ kho bhikkhu anattaniyaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo ti || ||
sn22.69:2.1: Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsīti || || 6
sn22.69:2.2: Rūpaṃ kho bhante anattaniyaṃ || tatra me chando pahātabbo || ||
sn22.69:2.6: Viññāṇam anattaniyaṃ || tatra me chando pahātabbo || ||
sn22.69:2.7: Imassa khvāham bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānāmīti || || 7
sn22.69:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsi || ||
sn22.69:3.3: Rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu anattaniyaṃ || tatra te chando pahātabbo || ||
sn22.69:3.7: Viññāṇam anattaniyam || tatra te chando pahātabbo || ||
sn22.69:3.8: Imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo ti || || 8-9 Atha || pa ||
sn22.69:3.9: Aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti || || 1-2
